title: Why the Torah was given to Klal Yisrael
summary: Lessons in derech eretz from how meat is prepared and a cup of wine is drunk, and the bitter beans that turn sweet after seven boilings. Why the Torah was given to Klal Yisrael: they are the boldest of nations, and the Torah channels that strength. Also walking with a stick and being carried on Yom Tov.
